correctness: Generate fresh sequentialCPU500 top10 and compare preserved first25; two paired verify1 rounds, one perB, with all scores/bounds/thresholds/schedules/skipped-losers and external ordered outputs checked before timing.

timing.boundary: Unchanged parent query wall boundary includes weights/upload/reset, seed scoring/selection, bounds, compaction/count transfer, survivor scoring, merge and winner copy. Excludes index/plane preparation, oracle and diagnostic threshold transfer, file I/O.
timing.primary: Mean of query-wise log median(pruned)/median(control) across3processes and500queries, exponentiated; each process and historical25 also reported.
timing.uncertainty: 10000 crossed process/query resamples, seed20261111; conditional repeated-calibration interval with only3processes.
timing.stopping: Fixed processes/rounds. Stop on correctness/runtime/build failure. Defer timing after10min occupied GPU; no optional stopping/tuning.

fixed_algorithm.seed_policy: first16 identity blocks;256 seed documents atB16,512 atB32
fixed_algorithm.skip: strictly below kth real-seed threshold; retain equal bounds

profiling.nsys: CUDA kernel/API/memory trace plus application allocation tracking.
profiling.ncu: DRAM read/write sum counters; kernel replay, cache-control none, clock-control none.
profiling.failure: Retain missing counters/permissions as unknown; never replace them with analytical byte estimates.
profiling.qualification: Profiled timings are diagnostic and not ordinary latency. Allocation tracking does not establish board/context peak.

limits: Both paths share pruning metadata in each paired timing process.
CPU and other host differences prevent attributing raw cross-host wall latency solely to GPU architecture.
No held-out, service-tail, memory-reduction or external-superiority claim.
public_summary_packaging: Actual full specs/runtime gates precede compute in private records; this public summary is packaged after launch and discloses that deviation from CONTRIBUTING.md.
